_note: Seed state only. The runner rewrites this file every tick; the copy in git is what a fresh deploy starts from (Render's free disk is ephemeral). It deliberately carries NO 'bybit_real_start': that key anchored the book to a BALANCE, and a balance re-read after a restart made the book snap back to exactly QUANT_CAPITAL, erasing every trade from the equity. 'book_start_ms' replaces it: a timestamp cannot go stale, because the PnL since it is re-read from Bybit's own closed-trade records on every tick. Override with the QUANT_BOOK_START env var.
